description: Vertical layout primitive that applies the system's spacing rhythm between its children.

gap.description: Vertical spacing between children, from the intent spacing scale.

default.description: Any flow content to stack vertically.

handled: Purely presentational: adds no role, no landmark, and no tab stop, so the semantics of its children are untouched.

required.when: the stack groups a titled region of the page
required.requirement: Use a semantic sectioning element (<section>, <nav>, <main>) around or inside the stack. aihio-stack does not create a landmark.

counterExamples.reason: gap="medium" is not valid. The scale is tight, sm, md, lg.
Hand-rolled spacing drifts from the token scale. Use aihio-stack so the rhythm stays system-owned.
